Tokio is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2017 to 2025.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (2).

Most recently: [astudo](@/work/astudo.md); [streamflow](@/work/streamflow.md): Stream Flow - Fast Stream Processing in Rust.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Tokio: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Tokio to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
